Name: Asyncritus
Summary: Asyncritus was a Christian in Rome greeted by Paul alongside Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, and Hermes.
KeyStory: Asyncritus was a Christian in Rome greeted by Paul alongside Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, and Hermes.
LifeLesson: Every believer greeted by name matters to the church and to the Lord.
